name: Demand
description: Demand rate UGen sequencer. Polls demand rate UGens when triggered.

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal to demand next value

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Resets the demand rate UGens

inputs.name: demandUGens
inputs.description: Demand rate UGens to poll

name: TDuty
description: Demand rate trigger generator. Generates triggers with inter-onset times from a demand UGen.

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Demand UGen providing duration between triggers

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Reset signal

inputs.name: doneAction
inputs.description: Action when sequence completes

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Level of output trigger

inputs.name: gapFirst
inputs.description: If 1, waits first duration before first trigger

name: Dseq
description: Demand rate sequence. Outputs values from an array in sequence.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of values to sequence through

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Number of times to repeat the entire sequence

name: Dser
description: Demand rate series. Outputs values from an array, repeating each value.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of values

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Total number of values to output

name: Drand
description: Demand rate random selection. Randomly selects values from an array.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of values to choose from

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Number of values to output

name: Dxrand
description: Demand rate random without immediate repetition. Like Drand but never repeats the previous value.

inputs.name: array
inputs.description: Array of values to choose from

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Number of values to output

name: Dseries
description: Demand rate arithmetic series. Generates start, start+step, start+2*step, etc.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Starting value

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Step size to add each time

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Dgeom
description: Demand rate geometric series. Generates start, start*grow, start*grow^2, etc.

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Starting value

inputs.name: grow
inputs.description: Multiplication factor

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Dbrown
description: Demand rate brownian motion. Random walk with specified step size bounds.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Maximum step size per iteration

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Dwhite
description: Demand rate white noise. Generates random values uniformly distributed between lo and hi.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Dibrown
description: Demand rate integer brownian motion. Like Dbrown but returns integer values.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value

inputs.name: step
inputs.description: Maximum step for each new value

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Diwhite
description: Demand rate integer white noise. Like Dwhite but returns integer values.

inputs.name: lo
inputs.description: Minimum value

inputs.name: hi
inputs.description: Maximum value

inputs.name: length
inputs.description: Number of values to generate

name: Dbufrd
description: Buffer read demand UGen. Reads values from a buffer at the given index.

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number to read from

inputs.name: phase
inputs.description: Index into the buffer

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: When phase exceeds number of frames, loop when set to 1

name: Dbufwr
description: Buffer write demand UGen. Writes values into a buffer at the given index.

inputs.name: input
inputs.description: Single channel input value to write

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number to write to (single channel buffer)

inputs.name: phase
inputs.description: Index into the buffer

inputs.name: loop
inputs.description: When phase exceeds number of frames, loop when set to 1

name: Dconst
description: Demand rate analog of Pconst. Outputs values from a child stream until their sum reaches the given total; the last value is truncated to match exactly.

inputs.name: sum
inputs.description: Target sum to reach. Sampled once per reset; cannot be modulated until next reset

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Demand-rate stream providing the output values

inputs.name: tolerance
inputs.description: Stop tolerance: stops when abs(runningsum - sum) <= tolerance

name: Ddup
description: Demand rate input replicator. Repeats each value from input n times.

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Number of repeats (can be a demand UGen)

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input UGen to replicate values from

name: Dstutter
description: Demand rate input replicator. Deprecated alias retained for backwards compatibility — returns a Ddup. Prefer Ddup.

inputs.name: n
inputs.description: Number of repeats (can be a demand UGen)

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input UGen to replicate values from

name: Dshuf
description: Demand rate shuffled sequence. Shuffles the array once and returns its values in that order, repeating the whole shuffled sequence.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Array of values or other UGens to shuffle

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Number of times to repeat the shuffled sequence

name: Dwrand
description: Demand rate weighted random sequence. Selects values from list according to a weights array (which should sum to 1.0).

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Array of values or other UGens

inputs.name: weights
inputs.description: Array of selection weights (should sum to 1.0)

inputs.name: repeats
inputs.description: Number of values to return

name: Dswitch
description: Demand rate generator that embeds different inputs. Unlike Dswitch1, embeds all items of an input demand UGen before consulting the next index.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Array of values or other UGens

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Which of the inputs to return

name: Dswitch1
description: Demand rate generator for switching between inputs. Returns a single value from the indexed input each time it is called.

inputs.name: list
inputs.description: Array of values or other UGens

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Which of the inputs to return

name: Dreset
description: Demand rate reset. Passes through values from a demand UGen, resetting it whenever the reset input crosses from non-positive to positive.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Demand UGen producing values which are passed through

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: When crossing from non-positive to positive, resets the input

name: Dpoll
description: Print the current output value of a demand rate UGen. For debugging; printing from the server is CPU intensive.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: UGen to poll values from

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Label string id

inputs.name: run
inputs.description: Active if 1, inactive if 0; can be a demand UGen

inputs.name: trigid
inputs.description: Trigger id (used to dispatch /tr OSC messages); -1 disables

name: Duty
description: Demand results from demand rate UGens. Outputs values from a demand-rate level UGen, advancing after each duration value (also from a demand UGen). Reset triggers reset both streams.

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Time values; demand UGen or signal — next level is acquired after duration

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Trigger or reset time values; resets the level and duration UGens

inputs.name: doneAction
inputs.description: Action evaluated when the duration stream ends

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Demand UGen providing the output values

name: DemandEnvGen
description: Demand rate envelope generator. Plays back break-point envelope contours (levels, times, shapes) supplied by demand UGens. Next values are demanded when each node is reached.

inputs.name: level
inputs.description: Demand UGen returning level values; if it ends, doneAction is evaluated

inputs.name: dur
inputs.description: Demand UGen returning time values; if it ends, doneAction is evaluated

inputs.name: shape
inputs.description: Segment shape number (see Env): 0 step, 1 linear, 2 exp, 3 sine, 4 welch, 5 custom curve

inputs.name: curve
inputs.description: Curve factor when shape is 5

inputs.name: gate
inputs.description: >=1 runs; 0..1 releases at next level; <0 sample-and-hold

inputs.name: reset
inputs.description: Crossing from non-positive to positive resets at next level; >1 resets immediately

inputs.name: levelScale
inputs.description: Demand UGen returning level scaling values

inputs.name: levelBias
inputs.description: Demand UGen returning level offset values

inputs.name: timeScale
inputs.description: Demand UGen returning time scaling values

inputs.name: doneAction
inputs.description: Action evaluated when level or duration stream ends
